text:
mara: opened a PR to update the Polaris-13B model card in the catalog — fixes include supported_hardware table, clearer sequence limits, corrected benchmark numbers, and an SDK migration diff. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/1499

docs-bot: CI checks started for PR #1499 — spellcheck / linkcheck / preview generation queued

kevin: quick q — the throughput numbers look high compared to our last runs. what machine/seq len did you use?

mara: notes in the PR description. 1xA100-40GB (we used the 40GB image for this run), batch sweep [1,4,8], seq=1024 for throughput. raw CSV attached.

ryan: FYI runtime v2.2 changed default streaming behavior. the SDK snippet should explicitly set stream=True to preserve previous streaming semantics; otherwise folks may see buffered responses.

sophie: also the Python snippet still follows the legacy responses.create param shape we removed in SDK v1.4 — users will hit a TypeError if they copy/paste. can we include an explicit old->new diff?

mara: pushed an updated snippet + tiny migration diff. PTAL: 

```
- from redwood import Client
- client = Client(api_key=os.environ["REDWOOD_API_KEY"])
- resp = client.responses.create(prompt="Summarize...", max_output_tokens=512)
+ from redwood import RedwoodClient
+ client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ["REDWOOD_API_KEY"])
+ resp = client.responses.create(model="polaris-13b", input="Summarize...", max_tokens=512, stream=True)
```

kevin: looks good. tiny nit: normalize `max_output_tokens` -> `max_tokens` across the catalog. and double-check the throughput units — I saw 18.2 in the table but CSV is 182 for batch=8.

mara: thanks — decimal-place import bug. fixed table to 182 tok/s (batch=8, seq=1024). added a short methodology note: "tokens/sec measured as summed decoded tokens over a steady-state 60s window."

ryan: i'll re-run the dedicated-pool bench tomorrow (A100 pinned 1 slot) and post the CSV plus p95 latencies; will also test H100 on prod infra.

sophie: added a compatibility paragraph: runtime images <v2.1 do not support the `q4_k_mad` quant profile. included fallback guidance and link to the quantization compatibility matrix. also fixed an SDK docs link that pointed to /sdk/python/responses-old -> now /sdk/python/responses (relative link).

docs-bot: CI checks passed for PR #1499 — preview build available: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/model-catalog/polaris-13b

mara: merging in ~1hr if no more comments. ping me for last-minute notes. thanks everyone!
